hooks.command: case "$CLAUDE_FILE" in *configurator/gameConfigSchema.js) echo '[hook] WARNING: this is a GENERATED file. Revert the edit, change contracts/game-config.schema.json instead, then run: npm run generate:schema' ;; esac

case "$CLAUDE_FILE" in *.js|*.css|*.html|*.json|*.md|*.yml|*.yaml) npx prettier --write --ignore-unknown "$CLAUDE_FILE" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true ;; *.py) (cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/toolkit" && uv run ruff format "$CLAUDE_FILE" >/dev/null 2>&1) || true ;; esac

case "$CLAUDE_FILE" in *contracts/*) echo '[hook] A cross-language contract changed. Update the Python and the JavaScript side in the same PR, and run: npm run check' ;; *toolkit/src/*|*configurator/*.js) echo '[hook] Logic changed. Run the validate agent before you open a PR.' ;; esac
